_comment: Edit this file. 'apps' is what the fly can open/close by name. 'tasks' are long background jobs it can run. 'autonomous' is the ONLY list it may act on by itself when bored - commanded actions are not limited to it.

tasks.disk scan: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem $env:USERPROFILE -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum | ForEach-Object { 'home folder: {0:N1} GB in {1:N0} files' -f ($_.Sum/1GB), $_.Count }"
